member.name: T:TaskHandler.TaskHandlerTelemetry
member.summary: Internal holder for the TaskHandler meter, activity source, and instruments, plus best-effort recording helpers. Every helper swallows its own exceptions so that telemetry can never affect task execution. When no listener is subscribed, spans are not created and measurements are discarded by the runtime at negligible cost. Thread safety: all members are safe to call concurrently.
